verdict.rationale: Deel documents an in-platform case view. Applicants can track visa progress with live updates and case-manager notes, see where the application stands from submission to approval, and get real-time status updates. Employers also get an immigration tab overview. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented next-steps or action-items view in the portal, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard experience.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product

citations.quote: Track your visa progress with live updates and notes from your dedicated case manager.
Access Deel and see exactly where your application stands, from submission to approval.
It's all managed within our platform, from eligibility checks to intake forms and application tracking
receive real-time visa application status updates
Get an overview of the company's mobility activities via the immigration tab
